source: FAOSTAT India annual production/yield and annual producer price index; see DATA_SOURCES.md
forecast_protocol: One-step-ahead annual prediction. Sort by calendar year and hold out whole years; each feature row uses only prior-year target values.

producer_price_index.units: index (2014-2016=100); not INR/kg and not mandi retail price

cautions: These are national annual series and cannot be interpreted as field-level yield or local mandi price forecasts.
Producer-price index is a relative index, not a currency amount.
All predictions are one-step annual estimates using historical lagged values only.
